Tooltip_craft_woodShedStorageDesc: 2x2 outdoor wood shed for bulk logs and planks. One bay. Hit R to swap south/east opening. Capacity set in Sandbox (default 400; needs JB Max Capacity Override above ~100).
Tooltip_craft_woodShedLeanToDesc: 2 wide x 1 deep lean-to wood shed. Hugs a wall. One bay. Hit R to swap south/east opening. Same sandbox capacity as the 2x2 shed.
